async def act(page):
    # Get the customer table (fourth table in the document)
    table = page.get_by_role('table').nth(3)
    # Get all rows in the table body
    rows = table.get_by_role('row').all()
    for row in rows:
        cells = row.get_by_role('cell').all()
        if len(cells) >= 6:  # Ensure it's a data row with enough cells
            telephone_cell = cells[5]  # Sixth cell is Telephone (zero-based index 5)
            telephone_text = await telephone_cell.text_content()
            if telephone_text.strip() == '2137418080':
                # Found the customer, extract name and email
                name_cell = cells[2]  # Third cell is Name
                email_cell = cells[3]  # Fourth cell is Email
                name = (await name_cell.text_content()).strip()
                email = (await email_cell.text_content()).strip()
                return f'Customer Name: {name}, Email: {email}'
    # If no row with the phone number is found
    return 'No customer found with phone number 2137418080'
